hero_canvas_animation_spec.type: Etched Camouflage Contour Lattice (Interactive Topographic Stealth Grid)

behavior.logic: Renders organic etched topographic contour lines simulating fine camouflage patterns and ZK proof waves. Gently morphs with mathematical sine sine-wave offsets and responds with subtle magnetic repulsion to cursor movement.

hero_canvas_animation_spec.scrollytelling: Staggered reveal for headline copy, real-time ZK pool counters, and action buttons with 0.05s stagger intervals.

scroll_animations.fade_in: IntersectionObserver staggered opacity reveal with translate-y-4 lift (duration: 500ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))
scroll_animations.button_hover: Transform scale-105 with shadow-md and background state shift (5px border radius)
scroll_animations.card_hover: Border color transition from light_subtle to light_medium or dark_subtle to dark_medium with 2px lift

landing_page.nav: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#08090c]/85 border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center
landing_page.hero_section: Editorial stark stark-monochrome styling. Etched illustration art background + live pool stats counter in dot-matrix font
landing_page.cards: Minimal white cards with 1px #ccc border, 10px rounded corners, soft ambient shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)
landing_page.buttons: 5px border-radius minimal buttons. Primary: White background with black text. Secondary: Dark background with subtle stroke.

mirrored_app_injection.rules: Apply #08090c dark mode base across all injected panels, override buttons to 5px radius, eliminate all bright purple or green accents in favor of clean high-contrast white/gray monochrome, ensure 'Camo Cash' branding is injected everywhere.
